name: Alcaracejos (Spain)
description: Red field with a thin white border set in from the edges, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Alcaracejos (a castle, a lion, a bridge and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of Alcaracejos; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Alcaracejos arms — castle, lion, bridge and tree
